example_de: Opa hat ein gutes Gedächtnis, er vergisst nie etwas.
example_en: Grandpa has a good memory; he never forgets anything.

example_de: Bei genauerer Betrachtung erkennt man, dass die Sterne ein Zeichen formen.
example_en: Upon closer examination, one recognizes that the stars form a sign.

example_de: Seine Einschätzung der politischen Lage ist recht positiv.
example_en: His assessment of the political situation is quite positive.

example_de: Unter Berücksichtigung der steilen Wege dürfen hier nur erfahrene Leute wandern.
example_en: Taking into consideration the steep paths, only experienced people are allowed to hike here.

example_de: Ich habe eine andere Auffassung zu dem Thema als du.
example_en: I have a different point of view on the subject than you do.

example_en: The court gives the lawyer access to all files.

example_de: Meiner Beurteilung nach ist die Verletzung nicht sehr schlimm.
example_en: In my judgment, the injury isn’t very bad.

example_en: What your teachers tell you is nonsense, I know better.

example_en: A good argument is based on reason and logic.

example_en: The pictures provide a stimulus for discussion.

example_en: What you’re claiming is absolute nonsense!

example_en: The parents have concerns about leaving their children alone in the evening.

example_en: Do not believe everything people say, but use your own reason.

example_en: With this in mind, I reassess the subject once again.

example_en: It’s a misconception that girls can’t play soccer.

example_en: My boss takes my work for granted and I want more attention from him.
